title: The Invisible Cheater
description: There's a new boss in the world
body:
He has 100 health points, but he looks like he's wearing 3 sets of netherite armor. As long as he has full health, he's not dangerous, except for his projectiles. But when he has 40 health points left, it becomes a nightmare:
— He teleports every 5 seconds

— He summons three stalkers to help him

— He fires ten projectiles that fly straight at you

— And if you torture him for too long, he simply regenerates his health

Drop from boss
